title: Remember, Reason, Run: Inside One Living Workspace (July 2026)
summary: Your Taskade workspace remembers what you make, reasons through every step, and runs while you sleep. Inside Workspace DNA: memory, intelligence, execution.
body_markdown:
Taskade has a free plan, with paid tiers at $10/month (Pro, the popular choice for 10 users) and $25/month (Business) on annual billing. All three layers run on every plan, including free. Custom domains and customer sign-in via App Users unlock on Business and above. Full breakdown on[pricing](https://www.taskade.com/pricing) .


---


**▲ ■ ● Memory · Intelligence · Execution**


The three-layer architecture behind every Taskade Genesis app, connected projects remember, agents think, automations run. Clone any live app above to feel the loop close itself, or[build your own](https://www.taskade.com/create) on the same primitives.
